name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Service & Account Support Professional
summary: Customer service professional with 15+ years explaining complex systems clearly to people who are not experts in them, across high-volume account management, software onboarding, and client advisory roles. Comfortable working inside CRM and software platforms on behalf of customers, adapting to policy and process changes, and resolving account issues under deadline pressure. Early career experience building compliance and reporting systems in a highly regulated industry.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals, objectives, and challenges.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured guidance, acting as the bridge between business intent and technical execution.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and recommendations, backed by rigorous tracking across operations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing automation tools.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value clearly to their own customers.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Managed and developed a 20-person, later 8-person, onboarding team, training new hires and building staff enablement materials.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and system integrations, building relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Guided onboarding alongside implementation teams, troubleshooting workflow design and resolving technical challenges during setup.

experience.title: Co-Owner / Operations Lead
bullets: Built compliance and customer-management systems from scratch in a highly regulated startup environment.
Developed early operational infrastructure, including intake processes and reporting systems, scaling the business to profitability.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
